; handwritten.blog
; SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
; Adds a confirmed send action to the open-notebook menus on reMarkable OS 3.27.
;
; Requires: qt-command-executor
;           handwritten-blog

AFFECT [[11313888899523275277]]
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor [[180922.180921]]

    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property ~&7083178290016&~ handwrittenBlogConfirmUuid: ""

            CommandExecutor {
                ~&5972374&~: handwrittenBlogExecutor
            }

            ~&214604601930&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: handwrittenBlogConfirmTimer
                ~&7713147298280334&~: 8000
                ~&495358363329399331&~: handwrittenBlogConfirmUuid = ""
            }

            ~&214604601930&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: handwrittenBlogResultPoller
                ~&7713147298280334&~: 1500
                ~&7083121289162&~: ~&6504329801&~
                ~&233743626668842&~: ~&6504329801&~
                ~&495358363329399331&~: handwrittenBlogPollResult()
            }

            function handwrittenBlogNotify(message) {
                ~&14825814810595278773&~.~&233726567442689&~({
                    ~&"6504315758&~: message
                });
            }

            function handwrittenBlogCurrentUuid() {
                ~&7083121450889&~ ~&7712934851008712&~ ? String(~&7712934851008712&~.~&5972374&~) : "";
            }

            function handwrittenBlogRun(command, args) {
                try {
                    ~&7083121450889&~ ~&6502785411&~.parse(handwrittenBlogExecutor.executeCommand(command, args));
                } catch (~&180974&~) {
                    ~&7083121450889&~ ({ stdout: "", stderr: "invalid command response" });
                }
            }

            function handwrittenBlogPollResult() {
                ~&197102514&~ uuid = handwrittenBlogCurrentUuid();
                ~&5972376&~ (!uuid) ~&7083121450889&~;

                ~&197102514&~ result = handwrittenBlogRun(
                    "/home/root/.vellum/bin/handwritten-blog",
                    ["ui-result", uuid]
                );
                ~&5972376&~ (result.stderr || !result.stdout) ~&7083121450889&~;

                try {
                    ~&197102514&~ status = ~&6502785411&~.parse(result.stdout);
                    ~&5972376&~ (status.state === "idle") {
                        handwrittenBlogResultPoller.~&233743626668842&~ = ~&214625660372&~;
                    } ~&6503784146&~ ~&5972376&~ (status.state === "succeeded" || status.state === "failed") {
                        handwrittenBlogNotify(status.message);
                        handwrittenBlogRun(
                            "/home/root/.vellum/bin/handwritten-blog",
                            ["ui-ack", uuid]
                        );
                        handwrittenBlogResultPoller.~&233743626668842&~ = ~&214625660372&~;
                    }
                } catch (~&180974&~) {
                    handwrittenBlogResultPoller.~&233743626668842&~ = ~&214625660372&~;
                }
            }

            function handwrittenBlogSendAction() {
                ~&197102514&~ uuid = handwrittenBlogCurrentUuid();
                ~&5972376&~ (!uuid) {
                    handwrittenBlogNotify(~&6504222003&~("Open a notebook before sending it."));
                    ~&7083121450889&~;
                }

                ~&197102514&~ preflight = handwrittenBlogRun(
                    "/home/root/.vellum/bin/handwritten-blog",
                    ["ui-preflight", uuid]
                );
                ~&5972376&~ (preflight.stdout.~&6504329413&~() !== "ready") {
                    handwrittenBlogNotify(~&6504222003&~("Could not send. Link handwritten.blog and try again."));
                    handwrittenBlogConfirmUuid = "";
                    ~&7083121450889&~;
                }

                ~&5972376&~ (handwrittenBlogConfirmUuid !== uuid) {
                    handwrittenBlogConfirmUuid = uuid;
                    handwrittenBlogConfirmTimer.~&233743006639214&~();
                    handwrittenBlogNotify(~&6504222003&~("Tap Send again to confirm. The tablet UI will briefly restart."));
                    ~&7083121450889&~;
                }

                handwrittenBlogConfirmUuid = "";
                handwrittenBlogConfirmTimer.~&6504295855&~();
                ~&197102514&~ launch = handwrittenBlogRun(
                    "/bin/systemctl",
                    ["start", "--no-block", "handwritten-blog-send@" + uuid + ".service"]
                );
                ~&5972376&~ (launch.stderr) {
                    handwrittenBlogNotify(~&6504222003&~("Could not start the upload. Please try again."));
                } ~&6503784146&~ {
                    handwrittenBlogNotify(~&6504222003&~("Sending to handwritten.blog…"));
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Portrait notebook menu
AFFECT [[11704595946725378272]]
    TRAVERSE [[454089850271038938]]#[[6504254477]] > [[254480451320573660]]#[[16710723433319324941]] > [[14125623155555875541]]#[[233724020048228]]
        LOCATE AFTER [[425121728314878811.15740235808997988493]]
        INSERT {
            ~&425121728314878811&~.~&432643201877711221&~ {
                ~&214632764553&~: ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.handwrittenBlogConfirmUuid === ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.handwrittenBlogCurrentUuid()
                    ? ~&6504222003&~("Tap again to send")
                    : ~&6504222003&~("Send to handwritten.blog")
                ~&8399601734642709923&~: ~&"7424592205469683787&~
                ~&233748328658231&~: ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.handwrittenBlogCurrentUuid() !== "" &&
                         ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.~&14953652214069020552&~.~&14593461789319363686&~
                ~&254542236275632405&~: {
                    ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.handwrittenBlogSendAction();
                    ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.~&15738511857451076348&~();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Landscape More Tools menu
AFFECT [[6025599999262907645]]
    TRAVERSE [[454089850271038938]]#[[6504254477]]
        TRAVERSE [[14125623155555875541]]
            LOCATE AFTER ALL
            INSERT {
                ~&425121728314878811&~.~&432643201877711221&~ {
                    ~&214632764553&~: ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.handwrittenBlogConfirmUuid === ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.handwrittenBlogCurrentUuid()
                        ? ~&6504222003&~("Tap again to send")
                        : ~&6504222003&~("Send to handwritten.blog")
                    ~&8399601734642709923&~: ~&"7424592205469683787&~
                    ~&233748328658231&~: ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.handwrittenBlogCurrentUuid() !== "" &&
                             !~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.~&14953652214069020552&~.~&14593461789319363686&~
                    ~&254542236275632405&~: {
                        ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.handwrittenBlogSendAction();
                        ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.~&15738511857451076348&~();
                    }
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
